# Philippine Legal & Compliance MCP (ph-compliance-mcp)

> Retrieval-grounded, citation-verified access to Philippine law and compliance
> over the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Statutes (Republic Acts, Presidential
> Decrees, Executive Orders, codes), jurisprudence (G.R. decisions), and
> government issuances (NGA memorandums/circulars, LGU issuances/ordinances,
> GOCC rules). A source-of-truth retrieval layer — never a guesser.

## Purpose

`ph-compliance-mcp` is a local stdio MCP server that gives AI agents grounded,
citable answers about Philippine legal and regulatory compliance. Every tool
response carries a structured citation resolved against the corpus; below the
confidence threshold tools return "insufficient corpus coverage" rather than
guessing. It is information retrieval, not legal advice.

## Key facts

- **Transport**: MCP over stdio (JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout). No hosted server.
- **Language/runtime**: TypeScript, Node.js 24+, pnpm.
- **Storage**: three SQLite corpora — `laws.sqlite`, `cases.sqlite`, `issuances.sqlite` — FTS5 full-text search, SHA-256 checksum-verified release assets.
- **Version-aware**: provisions carry valid_from/valid_until; an amendments log feeds show_amendments / show_history.
- **Knowledge graph**: citations_graph connects cases→statutes, cases→cases, statutes→statutes (only resolved edges).
- **Coverage**: 15 compliance domains (constitutional, civil, family, criminal, tax, labor, commercial-corporate, business-transactional, accounting, payroll, human-resources, remedial, administrative, local-government, special).

## Tools (16)

search_statute, get_provision, search_jurisprudence, get_case, search_issuance,
get_issuance, cite_validate, list_domains, related_laws, related_cases,
show_amendments, show_history, show_dependencies, show_citations,
show_implementing_rules, show_cross_references.

## Resources

- ph-compliance://domains — taxonomy + freshness
- ph-compliance://statute/{statute} — statute metadata + provision list

## Project status

Phases 0–4 implemented (foundations, pipeline, server, domain expansion,
knowledge graph); Phase 5+ (embeddings, hybrid retrieval, compute tools,
distribution polish) gated on roadmap. Verification of the full first-run
toolchain is pending a Node 24 environment (see state.md).
